items.markdown:
![Handmade Jewelry - Jewelry Making Process](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-de7b8944da8c:4)
Jewelry is made by `shaping precious metals and gemstones using techniques like casting, fabrication, and hand forging`.[[1]](https://plumbclub.com/jewelry-making-methods/)[[2]](https://www.whiteflash.com/jewelry-education/jewelry-manufacturing/)

Most fine jewelry is produced through a combination of digital design, molding, and careful hand-finishing.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtujezhMl0&t=107)[[2]](https://sarkissian.pro/blog/the-jewelry-manufacturing-process/)

### Design and Modeling

- **Concept:** A designer draws an idea or builds a 3D digital model using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software.
- **Prototype:** The digital file is sent to a 3D printer to print an exact replica in castable resin or wax.[[1]](https://thevaultjewelers.com/blogs/education/how-gold-jewellery-is-made-in-6-steps)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtujezhMl0&t=107)

See how a digital design moves from screen to physical form:

![](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRL0BHOYIOqGlD-ij5AFFHQmDBxhFQbEBAZiUQa2FyrhP70xB7j)
5m
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtujezhMl0&t=107) The Jewellery Manufacturing Process 66K views  · 5 years ago![](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url=https://www.youtube.com&client=AIM&size=16&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL)
YouTube · Jewelry Manufacturing for Designers

### Casting (Lost-Wax Method)

- **Investment:** The wax or resin model is placed in a flask and surrounded by a liquid plaster-like material called investment.
- **Burnout:** The hardened mold is heated in a high-temperature furnace, melting away the wax to leave a hollow cavity.
- **Pouring:** Molten precious metal, such as gold or silver mixed with strengthening alloys, is poured or forced into the empty mold using vacuum or centrifugal force.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dCQs4zz9ioM&t=27)[[2]](https://plumbclub.com/jewelry-making-methods/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtujezhMl0&t=107)

Watch molten metal fill a mold during the casting process:

![](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQnlPUM9mtTqIE-6ExxGCRXUpTKIbABF5FmlAn4nj3vmggjAVld)
57s
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dCQs4zz9ioM&t=194) How Gold Jewelry is Made in Factory 💍2.3K views  · 5 months ago![](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url=https://www.youtube.com&client=AIM&size=16&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL)
YouTube · Process World

### Assembly and Fabrication

- **Clean-up:** The metal cools, the investment mold is broken away, and the rough metal piece is retrieved.
- **Solder and Welding:** Separate metal components, prongs, or clasps are joined together using a torch and solder, or advanced laser welding.
- **Hand Forging:** Alternatively, some artisans hammer, bend, and pull raw metal stock into shape by hand without a cast.[[1]](https://jewelrydesigns.com/jewelry/jewelry-making/jewelry-fabrication/)[[2]](https://www.whiteflash.com/jewelry-education/jewelry-manufacturing/)[[3]](https://jewelrydesigns.com/jewelry/jewelry-making/handmade-jewelry/)

### Gemstone Setting and Finishing

- **Setting:** A specialized stone setter clamps gems tightly into the metal prongs or bezels using traditional hand tools.
- **Polishing:** The piece is filed, smoothed, and polished with wheels or tumbling machines until it shines.
- **Cleaning:** An ultrasonic bath shakes away any remaining dirt or polishing compound.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RU-JOoO8dIY&t=168)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtujezhMl0&t=107)[[3]](https://www.koshjewellery.com/pages/jewellery-manufacturing-process)

Observe the final steps of shaping, setting, and polishing raw metal into a finished piece:

![](https://encrypted-tbn3.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT_QFh-8Ok_QD9df6n-pVy2lR0cloyZ9xhXhxZOG9NGH-e4a0vr)
2m
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RU-JOoO8dIY&t=168) Golden Jewelry | HOW IT'S MADE 31K views  · 4 years ago![](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/faviconV2?url=https://www.youtube.com&client=AIM&size=16&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL)
YouTube · How It's Made

- How different **metal alloys** affect jewelry color and durability
